Only one (1) Fiscal year variant (K4) is in scope.

The fiscal year period in S/4HANA is aligned with the calendar year month (i.e., Period 1 = January, Period 12 = December). Special periods, if used, are grouped under December. For reporting purposes, the finance story in SAC will display results using calendar year months instead of fiscal periods.

Referring to the requirement under Coal Price Actual and Benchmarks, The Harga Batubara Acuan (HBA) chart and Indonesia Coal Index (ICI) chart leverages user-uploaded data in the SAC Model, ensuring maximum flexibility. The chart will always reflect the complete dataset as provided by the user, without pre-applied filters or restrictions, allowing users full control to decide what is displayed. Users may update or delete outdated data at any time to keep the visualization relevant and accurate.
